subject: design/codegate-v1
statement: codegate carries two subcommands at v1 — `run` (the ladder) and `capture-baseline` (operator-run, §3.10) — plus the conventional `--help`/`version`. New subcommands arrive by amendment to the basis or a successor design, never silently.
